q: Railway servant shall be entitled to 30 days leave on Average pay in a calendar year under which rule of IREC?
e: The logic behind the correct choice is explained below. A railway servant earns 30 days leave on average pay (LAP) in a calendar year — 15 days credited on 1st January and 15 days on 1st July — under Rule 523 of the Indian Railway Establishment Code (IREC) Vol. I. Leave rules (LAP/LHAP) govern the kinds of leave, credit, accumulation limits and encashment available to railway servants.
